test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 29 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1922a9abac1147521a167a08a6b46b1a3bb2ad241b423c2d01bea7ebafc10ecb.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The bottom elements and 2nd elements or 2nd column shift clockwise subsequently.

The top element is replaced by a new element.

The rest of the elements interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c933c68ba4385f2dc750d10062725716b1a1911ad878bdbabde4e66c77686b10.png] 

2) Second box series →

The bottom elements and 2nd elements or 2nd column shift clockwise subsequently.

The 2nd element of the 2nd column is replaced by a new element.

The rest of the elements interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1bc105c4b30a21abc4c4bca8cb93f01521130a2ec31278b84f56b087ed96820.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47db950581d45e0637819641bcbd32b38cfc62ab505d216970bed9377d773ded.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
